shortDescription: Three z-levels (sky/surface/basement) in ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. V1 deleted; per-frame cost cut ~94% and verified by measurement. Publishes as a new mod.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED** (156 files / 40,713 LOC). Current tree: **46 files / 9,070 LOC** — 37 in `Source/V2/`, 9 in `Source/Core/`.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`, so the column behaves as one big map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. THE ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`. Bands stack along **+z**, each a contiguous `CellIndices` range. `band = surfaceBand + level`; bottom-to-top = basement / surface / sky. An impassable, permanently-fogged **gutter** separates bands. Typical live layout: `200×768`, bandCount 3, bandHeight 200, slot 256, gutter 56, surfaceBand 1.

**`Slot` is rounded up to a multiple of 64.** Load-bearing: terrain shaders sample from WORLD POSITION, so a non-aligned offset makes identical terrain render with a different texture phase in the see-below view.

### The one insight everything rests on
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Two spatially distant regions sharing a `RegionLink` are adjacent as far as RimWorld is concerned. Both ends are `RegionType.Portal` (the stair subclasses `Building_Door`), and `Portal` fails `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom`, so the link **conducts connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum**. `Reachability.CanReach` is managed region-BFS, so it works unpatched — transitively fixing `ClosestThingReachable`, `RegionTraverser`, storage search and **every `WorkGiver_Scanner`**.

**Verified in play:** colonists cross bands for `HaulToContainer`, `HaulToCell`, `Ingest`, `Clean`, `BuildRoof`, `FinishFrame`, `LayDown`, `SocialRelax` — with no hauling code written.

### ⚠ Portal regions are ONE CELL — the multi-cell rule
`RegionTypeUtility.IsOneCellRegion(Portal)` is **true**: every door cell is its own Portal region. A 2×2 stairwell is therefore **4 Portal regions per end**, and a wormhole must link **every cell pair**, not just the building's `Position`. Linking one pair leaves the rest of the footprint conducting nothing, and which cell a pawn walks into decides whether the stairs work — the classic "works sometimes" symptom. `ABWormhole.Pair` holds `List<RegionLink>`; `AB2: band info` prints `links armed = N/M cells` with a `<-- PARTIAL` warning.

Also note `AllowsMultipleRegionsPerDistrict(Portal)` is **false**, and vanilla's largest door is 2×1 (Ornate Door). Our 3×3 grand staircase = 9 Portal regions is **beyond anything vanilla ships** — untested territory, watch the `N/M` line.

### The dividing line
| Class | Outcome |
|---|---|
| **Graph / logic** — reachability, storage, work scanning, hauling, needs, reservations | **FREE** |
| **Geometry / presentation** — LOS, range, targeting, path lines, ghosts, projectiles, labels, selection | **NOT free.** Every 2D-cell-space computation must be told |

Fix each geometry surface **at its own draw/compute site**. Never patch `Thing.DrawPos` globally — the see-below renderer prints below things at real positions then translates emitted vertices, so a pre-localized DrawPos double-shifts. (That was V1's `DrawPosOffsetPatcher`.)

### A third category found this session: reachability-as-proxy
Some vanilla code uses `CanReach` to mean *"is this a sensible place"* rather than *"can I get there"*. Cross-band reachability then leaks in. Confirmed: `WanderUtility.GetColonyWanderRoot` picks idle wander roots from gather spots / colonist buildings / colonist positions gated only on `CanReach`, so idle pawns **commuted across bands to stand somewhere** (the distance guard only protects the early-return path; the fallbacks are unbounded). Fixed by clamping the root to the pawn's band. **Un-audited siblings:** joy/recreation spot choice (`SocialRelax` crossings observed), meditation focus, animal grazing/pen logic.

### Hard 1.6 constraints
- Pathfinder is **jobified** (`PathFinderJob` : `IJob`; `PathGridJob` : `IJobParallelFor`). A* neighbour expansion is **not patchable**. Custom traversal lives at `Pawn_PathFollower`.
- `PathFinder` has **no `FindPath`** — managed surface is `FindPathNow` + `PathFinderTick`. Harmony cannot see inside the Burst job, so pathfinding cost is only measurable end-to-end.
- `PathUtility.BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on **unwalkable** cells (doors are NOT special-cased). Sky bands are full of impassable `AB_OpenAir`, so diagonal-only links are a real hazard.

---

# 2. MEASURED PERFORMANCE

Driven via **Modern Dev Suite** (`astryl.ModernDevSuite`) over its loopback API — `POST 127.0.0.1:8787/api/v1/commands` with `startRun`/`stopRun`; runs land in `<savedata>/ModernDevSuite/Runs/*.json`. Only **Live tab → Run full sweep** needs a human.

| Stage | Total mod cost / 2000 frames |
|---|---|
| Baseline | **3,791 ms** (58 patches) |
| After overlay + re-arm gate + V1 delete | **740.9 ms** (22 patches) |
| After event re-arm + lighting bake | **122.4 ms** |
| Same build, 17 colonists | **215.8 ms** — fps 59.2, f95 16.69 ms |

Fixes, each measured:
1. **`OverlayDrawer.DrawAllOverlays` postfix: 1.406 → 0.0018 ms/frame.** Swept every cell of the translated view rect with a `ThingsListAtFast` per open-air cell. Now iterates vanilla's own `OverlayDrawer.overlayHandles` (never cleared, so a postfix reads it safely).
2. **Wormhole re-arm: 0.339 ms/frame → 0, and no longer a patch.** Was a postfix on `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` (~4,500 calls/frame, early-outs on `!AnyDirty`). Gating it with a prefix only recovered 22% because the gate **added a second patch to a very hot method**. Now subscribes to `MapEvents.RegionsRoomsChanged`, invoked on the last line of that method on the only path that actually rebuilt. Registered from `ABBandMap.FinalizeInit`, CWT-guarded against duplicate handlers.
3. **Vanilla `SectionLayer_LightingOverlay` bake: 25 calls → 0.** Suppressing `Visible` stops the DRAW but not the BAKE — `Section.TryUpdate` does not check `Visible`; only `RegenerateDirtyLayers` does. Prefixed `Regenerate` to no-op on banded maps (safe: our layer calls the *static* `Bake`).
4. **V1 deleted** — it was never inert, only idle. Its patches stayed live on hot getters: `WorldObject.get_Tile` (2.6M calls), `Map.get_IsPlayerHome` (532k), `ThinkNode_JobGiver.TryIssueJobPackage` (111k), `PawnRenderer.ParallelGetPreRenderResults`, and `Thing.get_DrawPos`.

**Measured NOT a problem:** `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2.Regenerate` ≈ **0.9 µs/call**. Stripping below-layers from basement/gutter sections is a memory-only win.

### Pathfinding — the handoff's #1 question, answered
| Scenario | Banded | Vanilla ctl | Ratio |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ai.pathfind` | **556.6 µs** (188/200) | 944.6 µs | **0.59×** |
| `ai.reachability` | 1.152 µs (4999/5000) | 0.393 µs | 2.9× |
| `world.regions` | 0.339 µs (19995/20000) | 0.071 µs | 4.8× |

**There is no per-path regression** — banded is consistently *faster* per path across three runs. The real banded tax is reachability and region lookup, proportional to ~3× the regions/cells. Caveat: this measures path **requests**; `PathGridJob`'s grid rebuild is a separate cost this does not isolate.

---

# 3. LESSONS THAT COST REAL TIME

1. **Classify by BEHAVIOUR, not directory.** `SectionLayer_ABMountainCap` (803 LOC) lived in V1's `Source/Rendering/` but is live V2 code (its header says so). Deleting it removed the sky band's mountain-mass rendering; capped cells fell through to the black air-mask. **`Section` instantiates every `SectionLayer` subclass reflectively, so deleting one is invisible to the compiler — a green build proves nothing.** Audit before any prune: (a) grep candidates for `ABBands`/`Banded`, (b) separately check every `SectionLayer` subclass.
2. **A benchmark that surprises you is usually broken.** MDS's `ai.pathfind` lied three different ways: diluted by no-op iterations (`continue` but divide by requested), then contaminated by in-loop sampling (retry cost charged to the measurement), then truncated by `break` instead of `continue` (723 of 20,000 samples). Sample **outside** the stopwatch; divide by **effective** iterations.
3. **Nested instrumentation inflates outer timings.** A run arming 227 methods reported `ABBelowV2.Regenerate` 154× higher than one arming 29. Use a low-target run for layer cost, a high-target run for attribution; never compare absolute costs across differently-armed runs.
4. **`PawnRenderer.GetBodyPos` discards `drawLoc` for a humanlike pawn in a bed** and recomputes from `pawn.Position` — so sleeping colonists rendered perfectly, one band away, off screen. Lying *animals* were fine (the else-branch uses `drawLoc`), which made it look bed-specific. Fixed with a postfix gated on exactly that branch; a blanket postfix would double-shift standing pawns.
5. **`RenderPawnAt` only self-heals when `!results.valid`.** Below pawns are culled, so they never get `EnsureInitialized`/`ParallelPreDraw`, yet `results.valid` stays true from when they were last on screen. Run all three `DynamicDrawPhaseAt` phases at the translated loc.
6. **A malformed `About.xml` silently DROPS a mod.** RimWorld logs `XmlException: Data at the root level is invalid`, falls back to default metadata, and the packageId then fails to match ModsConfig. No "failed to find mod" error. Check the log's first 30 lines when a companion mod is mysteriously absent.
7. **Never mutate a collection you're enumerating from a callback.** `TickTransits` called `Carry` inside `foreach (pending)`; `Carry` → `StartPath` → `TrySegment` → adds to `pending` → `InvalidOperationException` out of `GameComponentTick`, **killing the whole sweep and stranding every other transit**. Now three phases: decide / remove / carry.
8. **Diagnostics that omit the discriminating field cost cycles.** Transit lines without `job=` couldn't distinguish "idle pawn commuting to wander" (bug) from "pawn crossing to haul" (feature). Adding one field settled it instantly. Likewise a verdict line that printed a conclusion the data contradicted (`CanReach=True with NOT FOUND` fired when the path *was* found) actively misled.
9. Misc: `menuHidden` doesn't exist on ThingDef · geysers are `destroyable=false` (DeSpawn) · `GenStep_Fog` fogs the whole map · `GenRadial` caps at ~79.8 · `MapDrawLayer.map` is private, use `SectionLayer.section` · emit ONE self-contained log message per event (separate `Log` calls share a stack signature and get folded by the monitor).

**PROCESS: measure, don't reason.** Pre-measurement the suspected hot spots were the see-below layers; they were nearly free. The stair problem had *four* distinct causes and every guess cost a cycle. Reach for a probe early.

---

# 4. DIAGNOSTICS (all live, all earned their keep)
`AB2: band info` (layout + `links armed = N/M cells`) · `AB2: transit health` (in-flight transits: age, job, distToNear, near-anchor band) · `AB2: below pawn report` (per-pawn DRAW/SKIP verdict with reason, posture, inBed, drawPos.y) · `AB2: why is this pawn stuck` (selected pawn: `CanReach` vs `FindPathNow`, all 8 neighbours) · **`ABStuckWatchdog`** (automatic: pawn within 8 cells of an anchor, unmoved 180 ticks while `pather.Moving`; classifies CONNECTIVITY / RE-TARGETING / BLOCKED and names the next-cell occupant or door state — gated behind transit logging) · `AB2: toggle transit logging` (now includes `job=`) · `AB2: below layer report` · `AB2: lighting report` · bisect toggles · `AB2: spike - build wormhole chamber`.

---

# 5. OPEN WORK

### Bugs
- **Transient stall near stairwells.** Watchdog caught it: `still for 204 ticks | job=GotoWander | dest 1 cell away | CanReach=True | path=FOUND (2 nodes) | destChanges=1 | pendingTransit=False` → verdict **BLOCKED** (movement obstructed, not connectivity, not transit). Self-resolves in seconds. The watchdog now also reports `nextCell` occupant/door state — **that line is the next thing to read.** Leading theory: arrivals landing on the anchor linger a moment before walking off. The 2×2/3×3 footprints may fix it outright by widening approaches.
- **COMBAT (highest priority, untouched this session).** Cross-band shots: pawn "fires straight down", projectile doesn't hit. **Two separate problems**: (a) *visual* — `ABBelowDynamicDraw` iterates pawns only, so projectiles below are confirmed never drawn from above; (b) *hit* — impact resolves in `Projectile.Tick`, independent of draw, so fixing (a) will make it look right while still missing.
- **Colonists sometimes don't spawn on generation.** Unconfirmed.

### Deferred, with reasons
- **Elevator (3-level shaft).** User wants it. Needs TWO counterparts on one building → a second scribed reference and a rework of `TryEstablish`'s single-`counterpart` assumption. Deliberately not bundled with the region-linking rewrite so a regression is attributable.
- **Transplant** (generate a normal map at full fidelity, move it into band 1) — fixes the coastline caveat (**use inland tiles for now**), save migration, true-lazy banding.
- Turret cross-band targeting · drafted move ghost · per-band biome consumers · sky richness.

### Perf backlog
Map gen ~3× slower · isolate `PathGridJob` grid-rebuild cost · compat audit not started (MissileGirl, PrePatcher, Faster Game Loading, Performance Esmolas, Performance Optimizer, Clean Pathfinding 2, Kingfisher).

### `ABBandEnv` — read before touching biomes
V2's one genuine regression vs V1: `Map.Biome` is get-only and derived from the world tile, so per-band biome must be fed to each consumer explicitly (done for `WildPlantSpawner` density, `GenTemperature`, two `CellFinder` edge-cell patches). **A contextual `map.Biome` getter driven by an ambient "current cell" latch is DELIBERATELY REJECTED** — it is the lying-to-vanilla-behind-a-global-latch pattern that made V1 unmaintainable.

---

# 6. VERTICAL LINKS

| Def | Footprint | Cardinal approaches | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AB2_LadderDown/Up` | 1×1 | 4 | cheap, queues |
| `AB2_StairsDown/Up` | 2×2 | 8 | baseline |
| `AB2_GrandStairsDown/Up` | 3×3 | 12 | throughput, not speed |

Transit is a **teleport** (`Carry`), so there is no travel time for quality to scale — "grand" buys approaches, not speed. All inherit `AB2_LinkBase` (`DoorBase` + `Building_ABStairs2`), which overrides `blueprintClass` to `Blueprint_Build` and sets `useBlueprintGraphicAsGhost`; each def supplies its own `blueprintGraphicData`. **Without that override they inherit `Blueprint_Door` + `Door_Blueprint` and every link renders as a generic door while placing.**

`LandingCell` prefers the anchor cell itself when free (vanilla door behaviour: occupy briefly, walk on) and only steps aside when occupied. `ArriveRadius = LandingRadius + 1` — tied together deliberately, because a pawn blocked by a just-landed pawn must still count as arrived.

---

# 7. PUBLISHING STATE

Disconnected from the original upload: `PublishedFileId.txt` deleted, renamed **"As above, So below II"**, packageId **`astryl.AsAboveSoBelow2`**, `incompatibleWith` the original.

**⚠ BEFORE PUBLISHING:**
1. **`About.xml` `<description>` is still V1's** and makes **false functional claims** — promises elevators, vertical conduit/water/duct/chem shafts, psycast cross-level targeting, caravans, Hospitality guest tours, trader airships, "zero recurring cost until you build a level". A store-page accuracy problem, not a copy edit. User-owned text.
2. `About/known-issues.json` is V1's (18 entries).
3. `ARCHITECTURE.md` + `docs/HELICOPTER_VIEW.md` describe V1.

## Settings
`ABSettings` rewritten V2-only: 9 fields, each with a live caller. Map size capped at **200×200**, unlock toggle behind a red warning, enforced at chooser AND generation.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true` always. Companions **`astryl.ModernDevSuite` + `astryl.ModernDevTools`**. Palette pins get culled for Playing-gated debug actions — use the Debug Actions menu. **Banding happens at generation ⇒ needs a NEW colony** (quicktest qualifies). Map gen ~3× slower — expected. **Use inland tiles until transplant lands.** Transit logging and the stuck watchdog reset every launch — re-arm them each run.
